# The Grid & Table group shows twenty demonstrations a buyer can check

Terminal predicate: a first-time visitor opens the Grid & Table group of the Portal's examples and finds twenty demonstrations of its own; each card opens on a frame worth reading, answers one question a buyer of a grid asks, and meets the bar of #21140 (it resets, works at phone width, in both themes and by keyboard); no card is a twin, a bench or a test fixture.

## Problem scope

The group is the first a grid buyer opens, and the gate of 7 Nov on #20498 asks it for twenty-plus demonstrations. The slate read all 21 entries on `dev` by opening and using each one ([#21142, part 1](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21142#issuecomment-6924949418)):

- Six entries show the same six team names.
- Three demonstrations exist twice, once on the grid and once on the table, and look identical.
- Two entries are test benches from 2019, and one is a test fixture that says so in its own source.
- Two look like a product (`grid/issues`, `grid/headerGroups`).

So the count is met on paper and the tab does not convince. The slate's verdict: keep 2, renew 12, retire 7, and add six examples for capabilities `dev` has and no entry shows (pinned columns, a filter row on the grid, the built-in cell types, CSV export, server-side data, a streamed load). That is 20 demonstrations of its own.

**Why an epic.** Nineteen leaves, each one example and one pull request, are read together as one tab on Fri 20 Nov and again at the cut. #21140 held 24 subs when this was filed; the slate adds a set like this one per group, so each group's leaves hang under a group epic and #21140 keeps the groups.

## Intended solution shape

- **The tab reads in the order of a buyer's questions:** does it look like a product (the issues grid), does it scale (big data, the tree at scale), can people work in it (two ways to edit, two filter rows, selection by keyboard), can it be shaped (grouped headers, pinned columns, cell types, row heights, banding, animated sort), does it reach a backend (server-side data, a streamed load, export), and what the table is for.
- **One leaf is one example:** its folder, its catalog record (`apps/portal/resources/data/examples.json`) and its cover. A renewed example keeps its folder and its record id. A new example is a sibling folder `examples/grid/<feature>/` after the model of `examples/grid/headerGroups`: its own viewport, a headline, one line that says what to try, a theme button.
- **Data reads as real.** No generated placeholder names, no random words, no header that names an implementation detail. The frame shows its own scale where scale is the point.
- **Every leaf carries a Look criterion:** the first frame at 1440 × 900 and 390 × 844 goes on the pull request and is read by the design seat before code review. The cover is the last criterion and is shot with the producer of #20679.
- **Retiring is removing the record.** The folder stays wherever specs load it. A twin never counted as a demonstration (the Avoided Traps of #20500), so retiring does not wait for the new examples; the group reaches twenty when they are in.
- **Examples on the configuration viewport keep their host** until the workbench (#21143) replaces it.
- **Order of the build:** the big data grid, cell editing, the tree at scale, the country statistics, pinned columns and the grid's filter row first, for the read of Fri 20 Nov. Then selection, the row dialog, animated sorting, cell types and export. Then the rest.

## Out of scope

The other 21 groups (their own slate parts on #21142) · the card (#21119), the groups as data (#21141), the navigation (#21130) and the workbench (#21143) · the cover producer (#20679, on `dev`) · engine features `dev` does not have: row grouping, aggregation and pivot get no example and no caption that suggests them.

## Avoided traps

- **Counting twins, panes or modes** to reach twenty.
- **Calling value banding row grouping, or a view loaded from JSON a server-side row model** (both from #20500).
- **Renewing the locked-columns fixture.** Its geometry is a test contract for 14 spec files; it gets a new example beside it.
- **A leaf per finding.** One example is one pull request, whatever the read found in it.

## Epic Review by @neo-opus-ada (Claude Code)

### Stage 1 — Roadmap Fit

✅ This is the Grid & Table group of cornerstone 1 (#21140) in ROADMAP.md's Engine 14 section, measured against the gate clause "every example names what it proves". The six `v14.0` leaves are the ones the read on Fri 20 Nov needs. No sibling epic covers the group.

### Stage 2 — Approach Elegance

✅ It builds on what `dev` already has: catalog records, `Portal.model.Example.publishes()`, the covers producer of #20679, and engine primitives (`grid.footer.Toolbar`, `showHeaderFilters`, `locked`, the `currency` and `countryFlag` columns). Renewing in place keeps ids and spec contracts. One example per PR keeps each read testable.

### Stage 2.5 — Source Discussion Criteria Mapping Gate

N/A: the source is the slate issue #21142, not a Discussion.

### Stage 3 — Sub-Structure Coherence

⚠️ Coverage holds: 2 kept + 12 renewed + 6 new = 20. The 7 retirements are #21186's six plus `grid-locked-columns`, which #21167 points at its new example. The leaves leave two boundaries unstated:

1. **A new example gets no card until its cover is on `neomjs/pages` `main`.** `publishes()` (`apps/portal/model/Example.mjs:120`) drops a record without `image`, and off Pages the list loads covers from `raw.githubusercontent.com/neomjs/pages/main/…` (`apps/portal/view/examples/List.mjs:79`). The family case of `TabContainerController.spec.mjs` asserts that the catalog's Grid & Table ids equal the covered card ids, so a record without `image` turns it red. For #21168 and #21187–#21190, the clause "or the PR names the change that brings it" would merge a card the tab never shows. For new examples, the cover is part of done. Renewals can keep their old cover until a batched re-shoot before Fri 20 Nov.
2. **One serialization point.** `coveredGridTableIds` and `{Grid: 14, Table: 7}` in that spec, plus the group's rows in `examples.json`, change in #21186 (−6), in each new leaf (+1), and in #21166 if its id is renamed. Each PR recounts against the `dev` it rebases on.

#21186 is unblocked: PR #21162 merged on 16 Nov at 21:00Z, and PR #21182 is on `dev`. Its `"seo": false` step therefore takes the unconditional branch, and so does #21167's.

* fix(build): a tile in a declared capture family needs no card recipe (#21454)

validateCaptureRecipes() asked every covered record of a declared family for
a recipe. Tiles (#21418) take their crop from the manifest's tiles list, so
declaring lists here made list-base, chip-list and color-list fail the
validation once dev's tiles met this branch. The rule now skips
kind: 'component'; a card beside a tile still needs its recipe.

Units: CaptureExamples and the Portal examples catalog, 63 passed; the new
arm fails on the old rule.

* feat(examples): the markdown example streams on open, process and splitter get content, five records leave the catalog (#21474)

The markdown example starts its stream demo on its first mount, so the
page shows its proof without a click. The process example tells a trip
in four English stages instead of German headings over lorem ipsum, and
the splitter's panels hold a folder list and an inbox. Process and
splitter become component tiles; the markdown record gets its cover
path. The four MWC records and the real-world process form leave
examples.json, as #21142's rows decided; their folders stay.

* fix(markdown): a streamed document ends as its one-shot parse (#21477)

The example's stream demo cut "Why transcripts need this" into a heading
and a paragraph, and drew its table without a head. Three faults in the
parser's streaming path:

- A heading or break always settled, even while its line was still
  arriving. It now stays open until its line ends.
- The empty string after a final newline counted as a blank line, so a
  paragraph, list, quote or table that ended in a newline settled before
  its next line arrived, and a table header never met its delimiter. A
  block that reaches it now stays open, and its source keeps the newline
  the next append continues.
- A tail that turned into another block type kept its id, and child ids
  were numbered in creation order, so a re-parse gave one node's id to a
  node of another kind: the differ kept the paragraph's text where the
  table head belonged. A tail of a new type is now a new block, and a
  child id carries its node's kind.

A new spec streams a document with every block type in chunks of 1 to
24 characters: it ends in the same blocks as one parse, and no id names
two kinds of node. All seven arms fail on dev's parser. The promotion
spec now expects the table under a fresh id.

* feat(examples): More components declares its captures: the markdown card and the process and splitter tiles (#21474)

components joins the declared capture families with one card recipe:
the end of the document the markdown page streams on open, its table
under a head and its hostile HTML rendered as text. Process and
splitter join the tile list. The process example opens horizontal, so
its tile shows the trip's four stages in a row.

The count pins follow examples.json: 111 records, 100 live (99 in Dev
mode), More components 12 of its own, 2 cards and 10 tiles. The tile
